scope: Actual continuous-time Brownian-flow relative entropy bound KL(flowLaw(mu)|flowLaw(nu)) <= ofReal[bridgeCost(L,T)*integral productCost under any P2 coupling gamma]. flowLaw is map of independently initialized actual sqrt2 Brownian configuration paths through constructed integral-equation solution. Proof composes genuine finite Gaussian histories, actual Brownian Euler law identification, exact deterministic terminal bridge conjugacy, Euler narrow convergence, polynomial grid cost limit and actual KL joint LSC. No assumed entropy-cost/Girsanov conclusion or target bound.
hypotheses: Continuous time/state drift, global bounded sup norm M, global sup-norm Lipschitz K for constructed flow, and global Euclidean Lipschitz L of flattened coordinate drift for dimension-independent cost. Positive horizon; actual probability P2 initial laws and any actual coupling.
scope_limitation: This proof establishes the continuous globally bounded drift case. It does not yet generalize to merely time-measurable globally Lipschitz possibly unbounded drift with integrable value at zero, which is the broadest manuscript entropy-cost lemma hypothesis. Coupling infimum optimization is delegated to root in BrownianEntropyTransport.
